description: This Java source file contains integration tests for loan account repayment calculations in the Apache Fineract project. It specifically tests different configurations of down payment enablement, installment multiples, and schedule calculations within the context of loan disbursement and repayment schedules.

classes.name: LoanAccountRepaymentCalculationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for validating loan repayment schedule calculations under various configurations of down payment and installment multiples.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured specifications and helper objects before each test.

methods.name: loanAccountWithEnableDownPaymentWithInstallmentsInMultipleOfNullRepaymentScheduleCalculationTest
methods.description: Tests repayment schedule calculation with down payment enabled and installment amount multiple as null.

methods.name: loanAccountWithEnableDownPaymentWithInstallmentsInMultipleOfSetAsOneRepaymentScheduleCalculationTest
methods.description: Tests repayment schedule with down payment enabled and installment amount multiple set to 1.

methods.name: loanAccountWithDisableDownPaymentWithInstallmentsInMultipleOfNullRepaymentScheduleCalculationTest
methods.description: Tests repayment schedule with down payment disabled.

methods.name: loanAccountWithDisableDownPaymentWithInstallmentsInMultipleOfSetAsOneRepaymentScheduleCalculationTest
methods.description: Tests repayment schedule with down payment disabled and installment amount multiple set to 1.

methods.name: verifyPeriodDetails
methods.description: Validates the details of a repayment period against expected values.

methods.name: createLoanAccountMultipleRepaymentsDisbursement
methods.description: Creates and disburses a loan with multiple repayments for testing.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithEnableDownPaymentAndMultipleDisbursements
methods.description: Creates a loan product with down payment and installment multiple configurations for testing.
